description: This file defines a module for managing and delivering text messages and previews in a Telegram extension, including handling draft streams, preview updates, error handling, and message lifecycle management.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Constructs a LaneDeliveryResult object based on the specified kind and optional delivery details.

methods.name: shouldSkipRegressivePreviewUpdate
methods.description: Determines whether to skip updating a preview regressively based on current and new text, skip mode, and message presence.

methods.name: resolvePreviewTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target message ID for a preview, considering overrides and current stream state.

methods.name: createLaneTextDeliverer
methods.description: Main function that creates an object with methods to deliver text messages and manage previews for different lanes, handling various scenarios including drafts, previews, and final delivery.
